meta.title: DeepSeek Usage
meta.description: Daily Token/CNY limits circuit-break subsequent model calls, show a warning and conversation failure reason, and reset at Beijing midnight. Customize sidebar Token, spend and API metrics: toggle, rename, change/upload icons and reorder. Reuse the DSH login for DeepSeek Platform account balance, bills and calendars, or estimate all local provider sessions with editable per-model rates, trends, model/session rankings and reconciliation. Billing is account-wide; there is no separate API-key billing connection. Local costs are estimates.
